title: Best Washer Dryer Combo in India (2026): LG vs Samsung vs IFB
description: We compared 6 washer dryer combos in India — LG, Samsung, IFB, Bosch, Whirlpool. Real drying cycle times, power use, reliability data. 4 picks + 1 skip.
short_desc: Combos ranked by actual drying performance.

headings.text: What actually matters in a washer dryer combo in India
Washer dryer combo vs separate washer + dryer

cta.headline: Apartment living?
cta.sub: Washer dryers save floor space. We ranked each model for Indian apartment use and monsoon drying.

faq.q: Is a washer dryer worth it in India?
faq.a: Worth it if you live in a high-rise apartment without balcony space, monsoon-prone city, or have a small family. Skip if you have a balcony, large family, or live in a dry climate.

faq.q: How much does it cost to run a washer dryer?
faq.a: Washer cycle ₹8-15, dryer cycle ₹25-50 (condenser) or ₹15-25 (heat pump). A typical week costs ₹200-300 in electricity.
Condenser uses a heating element (faster, power-hungry). Heat pump recycles hot air (slower, 50% less power). For Indian electricity costs, heat pump pays back in 3-4 years.

faq.q: Can I install a washer dryer anywhere?
faq.a: Condenser and heat pump dryers are ventless — install anywhere with water supply. Combos are louder than washers — avoid next to bedrooms.

faq.q: How long do washer dryers last?
faq.a: 10-12 years for LG/Samsung Direct Drive motors. 8-10 years for IFB/Bosch. 5-8 years for cheaper brands. The dryer is the typical failure point.

tldr_pick: Our top pick is the LG 8kg/5kg Inverter Washer Dryer (FHD1408SWS). Direct Drive motor with 10-year warranty, steam wash, and Wi-Fi control. The most reliable combo in India for Indian apartments and water conditions.
key_takeaways: Combos save 6 sq ft of floor space vs separate washer + dryer.
Heat pump dryers cut power use by 50% vs condenser dryers.
Drying capacity is always 50-60% of wash capacity (size accordingly).
LG Direct Drive motors last 10-12 years (industry-leading).
who_for: Anyone living in a high-rise apartment without balcony drying space, in monsoon-prone cities (Mumbai, Goa, Kerala), or with a small family. Also relevant for households where running two machines (separate washer + dryer) is impractical due to space or plumbing.
methodology: We compared washer dryer combos available on Amazon India, Flipkart, and brand stores. For each, we evaluated wash capacity, dry capacity, dryer type (condenser vs heat pump), RPM, motor warranty, and energy use. Cross-referenced long-term reliability reports from Indian consumer forums and service centers. Reviewed every 60 days.
